title: Gothic Dragon Girl Anime Battle
description: An incredibly detailed prompt for a theatrical-grade anime combat scene featuring a dragon girl with a spear in a futuristic gothic atrium.
promptText: High-quality anime footage. Near-future Gothic fantasy. Cinematic theatrical anime battle footage. High-density 3D Toon/Cel look only. Maintain theatrical-class key animation, high-quality compositing, smooth continuous motion with readable center of gravity, transparent lighting, and high-density background art. [Animation Direction] Explosive and sharp action. Sharp timing. Minimal anticipatory movements. Instant acceleration. Large, clear full-body movements. Strong contact recoil. Clearly leave inertia after contact. Dynamic camera integrated with movement. High kinetic energy. No waiting, long stances, long charging, slow recovery, or slow motion. [Role and Priority of References] <<<Image1>>> is the highest priority reference for face and character identity. Refer to facial features, age, eyes, iris, eyelashes, cheeks, jaw, bangs, horns, and drawings around the face. <<<Image2>>> is for costume, full-body design, and weapon reference. Refer to the same person's costume, decorations, body type, full-body silhouette, shoes, single long spear, and specific color scheme as in <<<Image1>>>. 3 is for tail reference. Refer to the connection position to the back of the waist, obsidian purple scales, a single tail naturally tapering from the base to the thin tip, and the purple light at the tip of the tail, same as the person in <<<Image1>>> and <<<Image2>>>. If there are differences between references, prioritize <<<Image1>>> for face, eyes, iris, jaw, age, bangs, and horns; <<<Image2>>> for costume, decorations, body type, and long spear; and <<<Image3>>> for tail connection position, scales, thickness, and tip shape. Do not copy backgrounds, text, frames, multiple panels, explanatory diagrams, or UI from reference images into the footage. [Fixed Protagonist] The protagonist is the same single dragon girl throughout. Maintain <<<Image1>>>'s small, delicate oval face, thin jaw, pale skin, small nose and mouth, large purple to amethyst eyes with multi-layered sparkle, delicate upper eyelashes, dark purple-black short bob with blue-purple highlights at the ends, and two curved black-purple horns on both sides in all cuts. Maintain <<<Image2>>>'s slender and well-proportioned body, black to deep purple high-collared Gothic costume, white chest cloth, thin gold edges and chain decorations, purple-black cape and wide sleeves, dark tights, black shoes, and single long spear. Maintain <<<Image3>>>'s single organic scaled tail connected continuously to the back of the waist, from obsidian purple scales to the thin glowing tip. Do not de-identify or simplify even in distant views or high-speed movements. In close-ups, return to the eye spacing, iris pattern, thin jaw, bangs, and horn positions of <<<Image1>>>. Maintain the same face, hair, horns, costume, body type, spear, tail, and color scheme; only facial expressions, gaze, breathing, combat stance, and natural delay of hair/cloth/tail may change. [Fixed Enemy] The enemy is a single, giant organic Yokai-Oni. Approximately twice the size of the protagonist, with soot-colored dark gray-purple rough skin, two ivory-colored horns extending backward, dark red glowing eyes, an ogre face with fangs, long messy black hair, a torn black-purple haori, and a single dark red glowing curse mark in the center of the front. Maintain the same design in all cuts; do not change into crystalline or crystal statues. Do not mix the face, eyes, hair, horns, costume, physique, or color scheme of the protagonist and the Oni. Avoid face averaging, costume swapping, cloning, or extra characters. [Shared Art Style] Line art is thin and delicate, line color is dark blue to blue-purple. Clear two-to-three-stage cel shading and pale intermediate shadows on face, hair, costume, horns, tail, and Oni. Shadows are centered on blue-purple and dark blue, not crushed to black. During movement, cel shadow boundaries should follow the 3D volume, with no flickering or irrelevant flipping. Color scheme is black, deep purple, amethyst, subtle gold, and soft white. Eyes and tail tip have multi-layered purple light, hair has thin blue-purple silk-like highlights, and skin is a clean matte anime style. Place incandescent areas only in narrow ranges at the center of contact, leaving high-saturation amethyst and black-purple around them to prevent whiteout. Distinguish cloth, metal, horns, scales, and glass with different reflections. Use directional motion blur only for high-speed parts; faces, eyes, hands, spearheads, and butts must be clearly readable. Soft cool white key light + weak warm fill on the protagonist's face. Background is low-saturation blue-gray and white-gray. Do not use thick black outlines, simplified TV anime style, flat coloring, generic 3D bishoujo faces, plastic CG, semi-realistic, realistic, live-action, or mixed art styles. [Temporal Continuity & Physics] Move stride, breathing, and tail sway from the start of the footage; no explanatory stills. The beginning of each cut inherits the end pose, speed, rotation direction, and screen progression direction of the previous cut; no re-posing, standing idle, or teleporting to starting positions. Supporting legs are fixed to the floor; do not slide soles at stepping, landing, or rotation pivots. Landing is sole contact -> knee compression -> waist sinking -> upper body follow-through. Spear reaction force is not absorbed by wrists alone; flow from elbow -> shoulder -> waist -> supporting leg to the next movement. Hair, sleeves, chains, capes, chest cloths, and tails are not integrated; they have different delays in the order of body -> hair/sleeves -> chains/cape -> tail tip. Hands maintain positions on the shaft; regripping is one hand at a time. Do not fuse fingers, wrists, and shaft; maintain front-back relationships of horns, hair, arms, spear, and tail. [Stage & Lighting] A near-future combat atrium with a giant glass ceiling and a two-level corridor. Thick white-gray structural beams, reinforced glass showing a pale blue sky, deep corridors, low-saturation mechanical equipment, and a polished light-gray reinforced glass floor. The floor softly reflects the girl, Oni, spear, and purple light. Clear parallax with three levels of depth: foreground beams, middle corridors, and distant glass walls. After falling, maintain the beam direction, light source, and vertical relationship of openings as the lower level of the same building. No readable characters, signs, advertisements, or logos. Uniform the direction of the cool white key light in all cuts. Blue-purple rim on the girl, Oni's dark red light reflects on the Oni and surrounding floor, and the girl's amethyst light reflects only on the girl, spear, tail, and nearby glass. No sudden exposure changes after large flashes. Do not hide faces, hands, spear structure, or Oni's curse mark with smoke or bloom. Use camera shake briefly only for strong contact and floor breakage. [Weapon & Tail] Only one long spear. Only the girl is the owner. Black long shaft, subtle gold decorations, one amethyst glowing spearhead, and one butt. Spearhead, shaft, and butt are always connected in a single straight line, maintaining the same total length, thickness, and decoration positions. No shrinking, bending, duplication, or deformation. Hands release only during throwing; order: empty hands -> same single spear in flight -> return -> grabbing the same shaft with both hands. During rotation, the entire spear revolves largely around the body as a single rigid body. Do not rotate only the spearhead; no transformation into propellers, windmills, or multiple blades. Only one tail. Continuously connected from the back of the waist; force is transmitted in the order of waist rotation -> base -> middle -> tail tip. No branching, duplication, or transformation into another creature. [Contact Causality] All contact must strictly follow the sequence: trajectory/gap/undamaged state before contact -> contact at specified position -> local light/crack/cloth displacement/gravity shift after contact. Do not generate magic waves, crystals, sparks, or glass cracks before contact. [Cut 1 | Approach] Rear diagonal mid-distant view near the floor. Start from the girl's back, camera moves forward as if catching up with the girl toward the Oni at the end of the corridor. The girl steps deep while keeping a single spear tilted diagonally backward and swaying a single tail low. Weight shift from heel -> sole -> toe. Cape and tail delay by half a beat. Shift axis over the Oni's shoulder, spear shaft crosses in front of the lens in foreground occlusion to a short close-up of the same face as <<<Image1>>>. Purple eyes catch the Oni, eyebrows slightly down, upper eyelids narrowed, mouth closed. Sink supporting leg and pass that momentum to the next rotation. Do not show the face static. [Cut 2 | Barrier Contact and Full Spear Rotation] Oni blocks the path with a dark red curse barrier. The girl doesn't stop, coordinates waist, shoulders, and hands to swing the single long spear largely around the body, continuous sweep from low diagonal to high diagonal. Hair, cape, and tail delay by half a beat. Camera moves diagonally around the outside of the shaft from waist-high mid-view, showing supporting leg, hands, full spear length, and contact point in the same motion. Thin gap between spear and barrier before contact. Short hit-stop only at the moment of contact. Thin amethyst circular wave is born only after contact, Oni's haori and messy hair flow backward. Connect reaction force to the next release. [Cut 3 | Throw, Return, Catch, Jump] Girl releases the shaft at the furthest point of rotation. Only the same single spear maintains a straight line, pulling a thin amethyst trajectory and flying toward the barrier. Oni tilts the barrier to parry, changing the spear's trajectory into a large return arc. Briefly show empty hands and the single spear in flight; girl grabs near the center of the returned shaft with both hands. Catch inertia transmits to upper body -> center of gravity. Kick the floor with that reaction force and jump over the Oni. Low close-up camera also rises along the spear's arc, changing from mid-view to full-body diagonal top view. Show throwing -> same spear return -> regrabbing -> rising in one sequence. Align spear with body centerline in mid-air, then turn to descent. [Cut 4 | Descent Contact, Crystal, Landing Rotation, Kick] Space between Oni's curse mark and spear tip before descent. Short hit-stop and narrow incandescent core only at the moment the spearhead contacts the curse mark. Only after contact, giant crystal ridges of obsidian purple -> high-saturation amethyst -> pale lavender rise in a fan shape. Crystals have three layers: thick main ridges, branching thin sub-ridges, and fine fragments. Translucent magic crystals of the protagonist's unique color, not bluish ice. title: Cinematic Beast Transformation Sequence
description: A sophisticated multi-part cinematic prompt for an urban night scene where a woman transforms into an ancient beast under a blood-red moon.
promptText: Format: 16:9 | Look: Photorealistic, 8K, 35mm film, cool-toned night grade, shallow depth of field, lens grain, cinematic hard cuts, dynamic camera per shot CHARACTER DESCRIPTION The Woman (pre-transformation): Mid-20s, Western/European features, strikingly attractive and beautiful. Fair, luminous skin with a soft cool undertone that catches the neon well. Long, wavy chestnut-brown hair loose around her shoulders. High cheekbones, full lips, expressive light hazel-green eyes. Slim, toned, elegant build, roughly 5'8". Wardrobe: a fitted black leather jacket over a simple fitted top, dark high-waisted jeans, ankle boots — modern, stylish, urban-night aesthetic. Minimal jewelry (thin gold necklace) that will later echo the beast's gold markings. The Beast (post-transformation): Tall, lean, unmistakably feminine — never bulky or male-coded, and not wolf-like. Slender long-limbed frame, long legs ending in black-clawed paws. Thick ruff of cream-white fur across the chest. Coat mottled black, gold and cream. Crown of tall branching gold horns. Fine gold facial markings tracing her cheekbones and brow (echoing the woman's features). Amber-gold slit-pupil eyes. Long membranous black-and-gold wings. Trailing golden tendrils drifting from the horns and spine. The transformation is progressive and layered — skin to hide, fur in a traveling wave, muscle lengthening, nails to claws, horns branching, wings unfurling — surface-level morphing only, no wounds, no tearing, no blood. SETTING A generic Shibuya-style crossing at night — no real landmarks, brands, or logos; invented signage text only. Neon in magenta, cyan and violet, wet asphalt mirroring the light, drifting steam, light rain haze. A huge blood-red moon dominates the sky above the skyline throughout. PART 1 — 0:00–0:15 — "THE OMEN AND THE COLLAPSE" Shot 1 (0–4s) — The Red Moon Opens tight on the enormous blood-red moon above the skyline. Long continuous extreme crane-down past glowing tower screens (invented neon kanji-style signage) toward the crowded crossing below, then pushes through the crowd to settle on the woman walking among them, one hand pressed to her temple, head down, unsteady, hair damp with mist. Shot 2 (4–7s) — First Tremor Hard cut to a low tracking shot at hip height following her boots across wet asphalt — reflections of neon rippling with each step — as her stride breaks rhythm and she catches herself against an invisible wave of dizziness. Shot 3 (7–11s) — The Collapse Cut to handheld medium pushing with her through the crowd. She stumbles, breath shallow, face pale under the neon wash. Her knees buckle and she drops to the pavement. Shot 4 (11–15s) — The Empty Ring Wide crane shot as the crowd scatters back in a widening ring, phones raised, murmurs rippling outward, until she is alone, kneeling, at the dead center of the empty crossing — rain haze drifting through the neon light around her. PART 2 — 0:15–0:30 — "THE TRANSFORMATION" Shot 5 (15–26s) — One Unbroken Take Extreme low angle at asphalt level, 24mm wide lens, only her right hand in frame, pressed flat on the wet asphalt, oversized by wide-lens perspective. Camera zooms hard on the back of her hand: pale skin darkens into hide, cream-white and mottled gold-black fur emerges strand by strand, fingers lengthen, nails darken into black claws that gouge the asphalt. Camera tracks and pushes along the forearm following the wave of fur, rises to the shoulder, swings around to find her face in tight close-up — still human, jaw clenched, terror in her hazel-green eyes — then pushes into an extreme close-up of her eyes as the irises flood amber-gold, pupils narrowing to slits, the last trace of the woman vanishing. Camera pulls back into a fast orbiting handheld shake as the white ruff floods her chest, gold markings spread across her face, golden horns branch from her temples, wings unfurl behind her. The orbit whips to the front as the fully formed beast rises to full height. Shot 6 (26–30s) — The Roar Low, wide-angle hold as she plants her clawed paws and throws her head back — a full-body roar, wings snapping open to full span, golden tendrils whipping outward, neon light rippling across her mottled coat. PART 3 — 0:30–0:45 — "PANIC, PURSUIT AND THE HOWL" Shot 7 (30–33s) — Panic Fast handheld at street level as the beast sweeps her clawed limbs and lunges forward, wings flaring wide. The crowd breaks and scatters, people sprinting past the lens, camera whip-panning through the chaos as neon streaks smear across the wet asphalt. Shot 8 (33–36s) — The Chase Beat Low tracking shot alongside her as she bounds on all fours between stalled cars and scattering crowds, claws sparking faintly off metal and asphalt, wings half-folded for speed, camera struggling to keep pace — motion blur and lens flare from passing neon signs. Shot 9 (36–39s) — The Climb Fast upward-tracking shot as she launches from the crossing and scales a building face in fluid bounds, claws punching into the facade, mottled coat and white ruff catching the neon, wings half-folded. Camera rises with her, orbiting outward to reveal the city sprawling below. Shot 10 (39–42s) — The Perch Cut to a slow dolly-in on the rooftop ledge as she lands in a low crouch, wings settling against her back, chest heaving, gold facial markings glowing faintly under the moon, ears (horn-crown) tracking the city sounds below. Shot 11 (42–45s) — The Howl Low-angle wide on the rooftop tower — she stands tall, lit by neon from below, the enormous red moon directly behind her, her crown of golden horns and outstretched wings rim-lit against it. She rears back and howls, fur and golden tendrils rippling in the wind. Camera cranes slowly up and back into a vast wide, city lights sprawling out, rain drifting across the frame as the shot holds on the silhouette-and-glow composition for the final beat. EXTRA ACTION BEATS (optional inserts to extend further / alternate cuts) Insert after Shot 4: a tight cutaway of a dropped phone on wet asphalt, screen cracked, still recording, neon reflected in the cracked glass. Insert after Shot 6: a low static shot of scattered crowd members frozen mid-flight, silhouetted against a neon billboard, as the beast's shadow sweeps over them. Insert after Shot 9: a brief aerial drone-style shot circling the tower as steam vents hiss below her perch, city traffic streaking far beneath. Alternate ending extension: slow-motion feather/fur wisp caught in the wind drifting past camera as the howl fades, rain intensifying, screen fading to the red moon.

title: Finger Frame Video Effect Prompt
description: A technical prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a live-action video of a woman making viewfinder finger frames with precise two-phase motion control.
promptText:
Photorealistic live-action video, shot on cinema camera, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, 16:9 horizontal.

Setting: A cozy indoor room with warm ambient lighting, posters on wall, hanging lamp, modern furniture.

Subject: A young blonde American woman with shoulder-length golden blonde hair, fair skin, wearing a gray hooded jacket. She faces the camera from waist up.

The video has TWO distinct phases — do NOT repeat the same motion throughout.

=== FIRST HALF (seconds 0–5): Horizontal spring stretch ===
- Both hands at face height. Thumb and index finger on each hand form L-shaped viewfinder corners facing inward.
- Purely horizontal motion: hands close together in front of her face, then pull outward left and right to shoulder width, then pull back to center. Repeat this lateral spring cycle 2–3 times.
- Smooth, elastic sideways pull. Forearms stay level. Elbows move outward as hands spread.

=== SECOND HALF (seconds 5–10): Varied finger-frame gestures ===
- Transition naturally into different finger-frame poses. She rotates and flips her wrists so the thumb-index frame orientation changes.
- Always keep thumb and index finger extended upright forming the corner of a viewfinder on BOTH hands.
- End with hands at a relaxed wide finger-frame pose.

NOT animated, NOT cartoon, NOT 3D render, NOT anime — real filmed footage. Stable camera, no zoom, no cuts.

title: Emotional Breakdown Sequence

promptText:

Sequence of actions:

title: Vintage 16mm Jerusalem Travel Vlog
description: A first-person travel vlog prompt that simulates a vintage 16mm handheld camcorder aesthetic, detailing a sequence of spontaneous interactions and scenes in Old Jerusalem.
promptText:
CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic, first-person/selfie POV. CHASE always holds the camera. Natural hand shake, imperfect framing, delayed autofocus, clumsy zooms, occasional face cropping. The camcorder is never visible.

LOOK:
Soft vintage DV tape quality with slight blur, subtle tape noise, mild highlight bloom, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, natural skin tones.

STYLE:
Raw, candid travel vlog. Genuine reactions, eye contact, spontaneous energy, quick handheld shots capturing real people and everyday life around Old Jerusalem. Nothing feels staged or professionally filmed.

CHARACTER:
CHASE, British female traveler in her 20s. Long straight brown hair, natural fair skin, soft British features, blue eyes, natural lips, slim figure. Wearing modest casual travel clothing with natural makeup and simple accessories.
SETTING:
Historic streets of Old Jerusalem surrounding Masjid al-Aqsa with narrow ancient stone alleyways, crowded markets, small shops, food vendors, wooden doors, stone arches, local families, elderly people, children, pedestrians, and worshippers naturally passing by.

SEQUENCE:

1. Selfie: walks into a crowded Old Jerusalem street, turning the camera toward the people, shops, vendors, and busy street around her. “There’s so much happening here.”
2. Whip pan toward a busy market street. A vendor prepares food while people walk closely past the camera. Someone notices CHASE filming and naturally smiles.
3. Walks through a narrow stone alley, filming elderly men sitting outside shops, families walking together, children passing by, and vendors interacting with customers. Ambient street audio only.
4. Turns a corner and suddenly sees Masjid al-Aqsa ahead. She stops walking and slowly raises the camera toward it as people continue moving naturally around her. “Wow…”
5. Walks into the courtyard with the crowd, filming the historic architecture, worshippers, families, children, and people quietly moving through the space. Ambient audio only.
6. Walks slowly through the courtyard, occasionally turning the camera toward herself before pointing it back toward the people and surroundings. “This place feels so peaceful.”
7. Sits quietly in the courtyard and films the people passing through the frame. She says nothing, letting the natural conversations, footsteps, birds, and surrounding atmosphere fill the audio.
8. Selfie ending: walks back through the old streets during golden hour, turns the camera toward herself with a quiet smile, then points it back toward Masjid al-Aqsa and the people around her. “I’ll never forget this.”

Turquoise double-eaves, dark wood structures, red pillars, and a massive central portal maintain reference image proportions. Clouds continuously pass slowly beneath the gate, between pillars, and around eaves, but without obscuring the entire structure. The gate itself is extremely heavy and stable, with no bobbing or rotation. A dark moon hangs in the distance within the central portal, with a thin cold-white light arc at its edge. It is a distant celestial body, not a portal, doesn't emit beams, and doesn't move fast. The dark moon stays near the central portal, with slight framing shifts only due to the protagonist's wrist angle. Sunbeams from the right form two or three stable diagonal light columns through cloud gaps. Birds fly in scattered small groups across eaves and clouds, not surrounding the protagonist or diving at the camera. Strict Time Breakdown: 0—4s: Cresting the slope to see the gate. Recording starts with the protagonist finishing the last steps of the slope. MiniDV at arm-length selfie view. About two-thirds of her face is in frame, forehead slightly cropped; only wind-blown grass, sky, and few clouds visible behind. Walking steps create realistic vertical camera shake. She pants slightly, left hand naturally tidying clothes touched by grass. Reaching the top, she slows down, looking past the camera. Her eyes widen slightly, but no exaggerated scream. After a short pause: "I just crested this slope... and I saw it." She remains looking ahead, not immediately refocusing on the camera. 4—9s: Full gate appearance. She stands firm, then slowly pans forward via waist and right wrist rotation. The camera passes her cheek, hair accessories, shoulder fabric, and slope edge, gradually revealing the city below and the gate in the sky. Auto-focus lingers on near grass before finding the distant architecture. A visible exposure breath occurs as bright sky enters; the gate whitens briefly before details return to eaves, pillars, clouds, and city. Off-camera, she laughs incredulously: "I didn't zoom in... it's really this big." Her mouth is away from the mic, voice muffled by wind noise. 9—12s: Dark moon aligned in portal. Maintains orientation, no auto-zoom or digital zoom. Right hand makes one small upward adjustment to center the portal and moon. Due to wind, composition has fine drift, not tripod-stable. Clouds pass behind pillars; birds fly from top-left to right; sunbeams light parts of the eaves. Moon remains stable, light arc clear but not blinding. She whispers off-camera: "Look at the center... that moon is perfectly in the gate." Auto-focus hesitates between birds and gate but doesn't lose the subject. 12—15s: Lingering at the top. Slowly turns the MiniDV halfway back to herself. Final imperfect semi-selfie framing: half her face on one side, gate, clouds, and moon still occupying most of the frame. Strong wind blows hair strands; she squints naturally, looks back at the gate once, breathing slows. No posing, just a light smile: "I want to stay here... for a while." Recording doesn't stop; she doesn't explain further. Camera pans slightly back to the landscape; final second keeps wind-blown grass, moving clouds, distant gate, and sparse bird calls; recording ends naturally. Environment Dynamic Lock: Gate remains suspended, no descent/rotation/movement towards protagonist. Clouds only move slowly through pillars/eaves. Moon is fixed, no enlargement/emission. Bird flight directions unified, wing rhythms slightly varied. Birds have scale change but no teleporting/cloning. Light beams stable. Grass ripples in gusts by zone. River flows slowly. Performance & Sound: Emotion path: fatigue -> discovery -> scale realization -> moon observation -> quiet presence. Rely on natural breathing, pauses, eye movement, squinting, and restrained smiles. No screaming/gaping/broad gestures. Mic captures: constant slope wind, grass friction, footsteps on soil, fabric rustle, bird calls, faint city bells/voices, close-range wind-muffled speech. No BGM, no AI narration. Negative Constraints: No photographer, no third-person back-views, no reference woman, no drones, no aerials, no external panoramas, no rotations around protagonist. No gate falling, no buildings flying or deforming. No moon turning into black hole, no explosions, no lightning, no doomsday. No bird attacks, no cloning, no static birds. title: Rainy Bookstore Lifestyle Cinematic Prompt
description: A comprehensive cinematic script for Seedance 2.0 that creates a realistic, candid bookstore scene with consistent character actions during a rainy afternoon.
promptText:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic video using the reference image. Preserve the exact same woman, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, bookstore interior, warm lighting, bookshelves, wooden furniture, and rainy weather outside. The video should feel like an authentic candid lifestyle moment, not a staged performance.

0–3 sec — Realizing the rain:
Wide shot from inside the bookstore looking toward the large rain-covered window. She walks toward the window holding her book, then stops when she notices the heavy rain outside. She looks through the glass at people walking past with umbrellas, her expression subtly changing to mild disappointment.

3–5 sec — Checking:
Medium side shot. She casually reaches into her bag, searches for a moment, then realizes she has no umbrella. She gives a tiny amused sigh and smiles at herself. Keep the expression subtle and natural.

5–8 sec — Giving up:
Close-up three-quarter shot. She looks back toward the cozy bookstore, glances at the rain again, then shrugs lightly as if deciding to wait it out. A loose strand of hair falls near her face and she casually tucks it behind her ear.

8–11 sec — Coffee instead:
Low tabletop angle. She walks to the nearby table, places her book beside the latte, sits down, and picks up the coffee. She takes a small sip while watching the rain through the window.

11–15 sec — Making the best of it:
Over-the-shoulder shot transitioning into a front three-quarter close-up. She opens her book and reads for a moment. She notices the camera, looks up, gives a small genuine smile and slightly raises her eyebrows as if saying “I guess I'm staying here.” She then turns back toward the book while rain continues outside.

Camera: Each shot should have a clearly different perspective — wide establishing shot, side profile, close-up, low tabletop angle, and over-the-shoulder/front portrait. Smooth natural cuts, subtle handheld camera movement, realistic autofocus and depth of field.

Realism: Photorealistic skin texture, natural blinking, subtle breathing, realistic hand and finger movements, physically accurate hair and clothing, believable walking and sitting motion, natural facial micro-expressions. Rain should behave realistically on the window. Warm indoor light should contrast naturally with the cool gray rainy exterior.

Overall aesthetic: Cozy Korean bookstore café, rainy afternoon, candid lifestyle vlog, understated K-drama atmosphere, natural cinematic photography, soft bokeh, realistic motion blur, 24fps, high detail.

Avoid: exaggerated acting, dramatic gestures, excessive camera movement, slow motion, sudden zooms, distorted hands, extra fingers, face morphing, identity changes, outfit changes, unrealistic walking, artificial smiles, or overly polished beauty-filter appearance.

title: Cinematic Running Shoe Commercial Prompt
description: A highly detailed, single-shot video prompt for a professional shoe commercial featuring falling sneakers against a vibrant blue background and a stylistic transition to a runner.
promptText: Live-action running-shoe commercial. 20 seconds. No cuts are used. The background is one flat electric blue from beginning to end. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no shadows. The shoes fall continuously from the top of the frame towards the bottom. Dozens of running shoes are in frame at any one moment. They are all the same single model and differ only in colour: a light, thin running shoe with a thick white foam midsole under a brightly coloured knit mesh upper, with one small silver tab at the heel. That tab is the same silver on every colourway, and there is no gold or black metal anywhere on the shoe. The colours run through orange, lime, coral, dark grey, white and pale blue. Every shoe falls from top to bottom. They all fall the same way; what differs is that each tumbles on its own axis, so in any one frame some show their outsoles, some their sides, and some are seen from above. Any shoe that comes close to camera enters from the top of the frame and leaves through the bottom; none of them appears or disappears in the middle of the frame. The near ones are large and sharp; the far ones read only as small blurred patches of colour. Focus holds on one plane and everything in front of and behind it falls softly away. The camera holds its position, breathing very slightly. What carries the frame is the shoes. Partway through, a torn paper edge sweeps across the frame and opens the layer beneath it. Along every tear the white core of the paper is left ragged and fibrous, and a soft shadow falls onto the layer below. Wherever she appears, the camera is in front of her. It never follows her back or the back of her head; her face is turned towards camera. The photograph under the paper is black and white: high-key, with the sky blown out to white, and coarse darkroom-print grain. Even inside that black and white, the shoes keep their colour. One woman appears and she is the same person throughout: a Korean woman in her early twenties, with clearly defined features, long eyes and a narrow jawline. Her hair is deep auburn, falling in heavy waves to her waist, with a few fine braids running sideways from the crown. She ties it back in a single tail to run. She wears three things: a pale blue halter crop top underneath, a dark grey sheer cropped bolero over it with long sleeves and thumbholes that cover the backs of her hands, and dark grey joggers gathered at the ankle with a pale blue drawstring at the waist. She stays in all three while she runs; they never turn into a running vest or short athletic shorts. On her feet is the white-foam-midsole running shoe described above. (0:00–0:03) The film opens on the side of a coral running shoe filling the upper left of the frame, close enough that individual strands of the knit upper, the grain along the midsole and the stitching all read. It tumbles on its axis towards the lower right until the inside of the shoe comes into view. Behind it, dozens more come down at varying sizes. (0:03–0:05) A lime pair catches on the top edge of the frame with only the toes pushing in, close enough that the individual strands of knit mesh and the texture of the midsole are visible. The rest of the frame is blue, with only a few small shoes coming down far away in it. (0:05–0:07.5) LAND LIGHT fades up at the centre of the frame in white serif capitals with very wide letter spacing, fixed in place. Printed on paper, its strokes show horizontal printing lines inside them. One falling shoe drops in front of the letters and another behind them. From the lower right corner a torn paper edge rises at an angle and peels the blue layer away. (0:07.5–0:13) Where the edge has peeled back, a bright black-and-white photograph fills in. The camera sits low on the polyurethane track directly in front of her, facing her head-on and retreating as she runs towards it. The white foam midsole reaches forward, compresses as it meets the ground and springs back. The shoes alone hold their coral; everything else is black and white. The camera rises from her feet to her face and frames her from the front, chest up and large. Her eyes fixed straight ahead, her face wet with sweat and her dark auburn hair swinging all read clearly. The stands and the sky behind her fall softly out of focus, and the sky is blown out to white. (0:13–0:16) The torn edge rises from the bottom of the frame and the blue layer comes back. A coral pair falls through dead centre with one shoe crossing over the other, the camera further back now so the whole shoe reads. A single highlight travels across the small silver tab at the heel. (0:16–0:17.5) A single sheet of electric blue paper, come down from the top, covers the frame. Its lower edge is torn, with the white core of the paper showing. (0:17.5–0:20) A bright off-white paper field. At the centre, two lines of thin capitals: LAND LIGHT, RUN LONG. No other lettering and no symbol. A torn edge crosses the lower part of the frame at a very shallow angle. The final frame settles on exactly this. This has to read as a real commercial film. The print grain applies to the black-and-white layer only; the blue layers are sharp. Lettering appears in exactly two places: LAND LIGHT at 0:05–0:07.5 and the two lines on the final frame. No brand name and no logo symbol appear anywhere.

promptText:
1. Segment Definition

Cinematic realistic texture. Utilizing a 'reference-image-driven living world system,' blending poetic Xianxia tension, space-misleading comedy, restrained performance, chilly silver-blue morning, warm sunrise reflections, natural volumetric mountain mist, and realistic wet stone and water physical effects. The final reversal must be achieved entirely through visibility changes. Geographic structure must be continuous; no sudden scene changes or terrain deformations allowed.

2. Reference Responsibilities
Seedance 2.0 supports image, audio, and video references; thus, all reference images are treated as a single world setting library, not isolated backgrounds. Reference images collectively determine:
Continuous terrain, architectural logic, spatial scale, material era, vegetation ecology, water levels and systems, weather status, cloud movement, mist density, main light direction, reflection relationships, sound distance perception, and realistic character movement paths.

Pre-generation Internal Environment Deduction:
Execute a silent environmental deduction first. Reorganize a unique new space based on all reference images. This space must be physically unified, structurally continuous, realistically schedulable by the camera, have stable foreground/midground/background anchors, and maintain the environment DNA of the same world.

3. Character Lock
Character ID A | White-clad Sword Immortal: Same 25–30 year old East Asian female sword immortal. Strictly maintain: @Image 1 (same face), black long hair, slender body proportions, white embroidered silk Hanfu, jade accessories, white cloth boots, and a unique long silver sword.
Character ID B | Green-clad Rival: Same 20–25 year old East Asian female rival. Strictly maintain: @Image 2 (same face), black braided hair, petite body proportions, green Hanfu, dark cloth boots, and a unique dark steel sword.

4. Storyboard Design
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide or Extreme Wide Shot
Goal: Establish a misleading spatial relationship, making the audience and characters believe there is a bottomless canyon ahead.
Content: Two characters stand fully from head to toe on two ancient stone platforms covered in wet moss. Heavy mist blocks the view between them, making it look like a bottomless chasm.
Anchors: Waterfall disappears into the mist; pine branches sway naturally at different depths; water droplets flow slowly on stone; distant tiled buildings appear and disappear in the mist; rising sun pushes the mist horizontally.
Performance: Both remain cautious and restrained, as if facing a great enemy. Establish the spatial misdirection first.

Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Goal: Both misjudge the spatial scale and prepare high-consumption sword-crossing moves.
Continuity: Maintain same characters, outfits, swords, geography, mist/platform logic, and environment anchors (pines, waterfall, tiled buildings).
Action: Both enter a charging state. Wide sleeves are lifted by airflow; sword blades emit low-frequency resonance; mist swirls around ankles. Dignified, formal, and restrained posture.
Dialogue: White-clad immortal says calmly: 'This sword strike crosses the canyon.' Green-clad woman replies: 'I'll be waiting.'
Camera: Slow orbital shot around the duo. Anchors must remain visible to verify space.

Shot 3 | 10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
Goal: Complete the reversal through visibility changes. The truth must come from clearing the existing environment, not generating a new one.
Event: A natural mountain wind clears the last layer of mist. Reveal: The 'bottomless canyon' is actually just a three-step-wide ancient mountain irrigation canal. Dark water and vertical stone reflections caused the depth illusion.
Hard Constraints: Continuity of stone edges, waterfall entry, moss, pines, tiled buildings, sun direction, and mist logic. Nothing should morph suddenly.
Performance: Both freeze with swords raised. Green-clad woman looks down slowly and says: 'Maybe... just walk over?' White-clad immortal silently sheathes her sword, steps across on three existing rocks, and says impassively as she passes: 'Saves spiritual power.'
Ending: Extreme close-up of the green-clad woman trying to suppress a smile. The formerly grand 'canyon waterfall sound' now sounds like a small bubbling canal.

5. Audio-Visual & Physical Requirements
Native synchronous Mandarin dialogue; consistent spatial sound; unified physical logic for wind, mist, water, and reflections; continuous natural motion and parallax; realistic movement for silk, hair, and droplets.

6. Technical Specifications
Strict duration: 15 seconds; 16:9 aspect ratio; 3 continuous clear shots; only 2 visible characters; no subtitles.

7. Negative

promptText:
SCENE 1 — 0–5 seconds: THE SHIPWRECK
A massive wooden sailing ship struggles violently against towering ocean waves during a dark nighttime storm. Lightning flashes across the sky as rain pours down. A young sailor loses his balance, falls over the side of the ship, and disappears into the raging black water. Use a dramatic wide shot followed by a close-up of his terrified face as he sinks beneath the waves. SCENE 2 — 5–15 seconds: THE MERMAID APPEARS Deep beneath the stormy surface, the sailor slowly sinks into the dark ocean. Suddenly, a mysterious blue glow appears in the distance. A beautiful mermaid emerges from the darkness and rapidly swims toward him. She has long flowing wet burgundy-red hair, the same facial features and appearance as the provided reference image, an elegant shimmering blue-green iridescent tail, a detailed seashell-inspired top decorated with pearls, subtle bioluminescent details, and expressive eyes. Her hair and tail move naturally with the underwater currents. She reaches the unconscious sailor, gently grabs him, and pulls him toward the surface as magical particles and soft blue light surround them. SCENE 3 — 15–25 seconds: THE RESCUE The mermaid carries the unconscious sailor through crashing waves toward a quiet rocky shoreline. The storm begins to weaken as dawn approaches. She carefully places him on the wet beach and checks that he is breathing. As the first warm rays of sunrise break through the clouds, she looks back toward the ocean. Before anyone can see her, she slips quietly back into the water and disappears beneath the waves. SCENE 4 — 25–30 seconds: THE MYSTERIOUS SEASHELL The sailor suddenly wakes up on the beach, coughing and confused. He looks around but the mermaid is gone. Beside his hand lies a beautiful glowing seashell emitting a soft magical blue light. He picks it up and stares at it in disbelief. Cut to a final cinematic shot of the glowing seashell in his hand while the calm ocean stretches behind him. A faint silhouette of the mermaid can briefly be seen beneath the distant waves.

As skeleton/undead, he has a skull and ribs twice as large, a black iron crown fixed to the skull, thick black iron armor, a torn dark navy cloak, intense blue orbital flames, and a black iron greatsword. No shield. He appears only after the three generic soldiers are defeated. All enemies maintain solid bone, cloth, and iron materials until defeat; do not replace them with crystals or light figures. No mixing of generic and King features, and no duplication of enemies. [Rendering Consistency] Use only 3D toon/cel-look. Centered on image1 and image2, featuring thin blue-gray outlines, two-to-three layers of toon shading with soft gradients, clear moon-silver, deep navy, and royal blue. Sharp fine highlights on silver hair, with high-density material expression distinguishing velvet, lace, metal, gemstones, and glass. Character-first/character-specific palette: Prioritize the protagonist's royal blue as the character-specific key light and deep navy as the character-specific shadow. Background uses a low-saturation palette, with cyan used only as auxiliary for contact light. High density includes exterior ribs, window frames, seats, hand straps, railings, connection doors, and floor reflections. No thick outlines. No single-layer flat cel painting. No generic 3D anime faces. No smooth plastic CG materials. No low-density backgrounds. No live-action or semi-realistic styles. No dull colors. Do not mix art styles. [Common Axis of Motion and Cinematography] Combat follows one continuous trajectory. The same line of motion is passed through the rooftop advance, falling into the window, breaking into the car, being pushed outward by the King's greatsword, pivoting inward, passing behind, the return slash, and the sheathing. The trajectory deforms upon contact but does not stop to reset. Camera systems switch based on purpose: low rear-three-quarter attacker tracking, diagonal exterior view, over-the-shoulder counter, short orbit/axis change, diagonal impact push-in, and side medium close-up. Low angle heights: 0.4m for roof/floor action, 1.2m for over-the-shoulder, 1.35m for sheathing. Allow brief foreground occlusion by seats or window frames; parts of the body may exit the frame during speed sequences. The background vanishing axis always flows toward the front of the train. Cut transitions are linked by foot grounding, window impacts, weapon contact, and the direction of body passage. [Speed and Sound] Full-body movements are real-time. Hit-stop on contact is maximum 1 frame. No long charging times, slow motion, mid-air freezing, or repetitive poses. Tense strings and low percussion around 150 BPM. Synchronize visible events with footsteps on metal roof, wind pressure, glass shattering, dry bone thuds on the floor, sword collisions, armor cracking, and the final sheathing sound. No dialogue, subtitles, logos, UI, or watermarks. Cut 1: 0.0–2.0s | Sprinting on the roof Low 3/4 rear view. The protagonist sprints four steps along the roof ribs; with every boot contact, the supporting leg, pelvis, shoulders, and sword move along the same axis of propulsion. Roof ribs and the canyon recede at high speed; hair and cape flow sharply backward. Using the reaction force of the fourth step, she jumps from the right edge of the roof to the side of the car. At 2.0s, her head, shoulders, waist, and both legs are all outside the intact window glass; no part of her body has entered the window frame yet. Cut 2: 2.0–5.0s | Breaking through the window from outside, entering the car 2.0–3.15s: Diagonal front camera outside the train. Lens and protagonist are outside the window, showing the silver car exterior, window frame edges, and empty interior through glass. She approaches the window from outside, maintaining a vector from outside -> glass surface -> inside. At 2.0s, she is fully outside; the window is intact. At 2.7s, she swings the entire single-edged sword in a short horizontal arc; the blade near the tip hits the center of the outer glass surface. Radial cracks appear only after impact at 2.8s; glass shards fly inward, away from the camera. At 3.1s, her head and right shoulder cross the frame into the car; waist and legs remain outside. Using flying glass shards as brief foreground occlusion, switch to an interior diagonal front view at 3.15s. Leaving the broken window behind her, the waist, knees, and boots pass through the frame by 3.7s. At 4.2s, her entire body is inside, landing low on the aisle floor. By 5.0s, her waist and ribcage cross two floor seams as she runs two steps forward into the next encirclement. Cut 3: 5.0–6.0s | Confirming enemy placement instantly The camera recedes from a front-left diagonal position at a chest height of 1.2m, placing the protagonist on the right side of the screen at knee-up size. Using the front connecting door as the vanishing axis, show the three generic skeletons closing in from the sides and front, her path, and the open central gap in the same frame. Her waist and ribcage cross one floor seam; by 6.0s, she steps between the edge of the left seat and the first skeletal arm. As the long phalanges of the front-left skeleton cross the lens, use that arm as a natural occlusion to switch to the next viewpoint. Cut 4: 6.0–7.2s | Entering the encirclement and beginning the pivot As the occlusion clears, the camera moves behind her right shoulder at a waist height of 0.8m, capturing her full body, supporting leg, single sword, and the three sets of ribs in close depth. The background vanishing axis shifts from the front door to the diagonal row of windows on the back left. She catches the floor with her right sole, briefly compresses her knee, and passes her pelvis over the right foot into a low clockwise pivot. The entire sword draws a single arc at waist height; by 7.2s, her body passes through the center of the triangle formed by the three enemies. The camera does not rotate faster than the sword, showing the kick of the supporting leg and the passage of the blade simultaneously. Cut 5: 7.2–8.5s | Crossing the axis in the direction of the blade, leaving the collapse behind Triggered by the blade crossing from right to left, the camera briefly orbits from behind the right shoulder to a low left-front diagonal, dropping height from 0.8m to 0.45m and pulling back from knee-up to full body. The background vanishing axis returns from the diagonal windows to the front door. The three do not wait their turn; they simultaneously begin collapsing into bone piles behind her passage line. By 8.0s, she is completely out of the encirclement; by 8.5s, she crosses two more floor seams. She does not look back, handing the moment of her next right-foot grounding to the King's appearance. Cut 6: 8.5–11.5s | Linking the King's appearance directly to a descending arc The pressure of a black iron greatsword pushes open the connecting door, and the Skeleton King enters the aisle in one step. Without pausing the appearance pose, he carries that step directly into a vertical descending arc with the entire greatsword. The protagonist, maintaining forward momentum, brings her sword up in front of her body. At 11.5s, they enter the contact line with a clear gap remaining between the two blades, passing the speed of the descending arc to the next cut. Cut 7: 11.5–14.2s | Receiving downward pressure for an instant, then immediate disengagement From behind her left shoulder at 1.2m height, capture both weapons, the pre-contact gap, and her supporting leg in the same frame. At 11.5s, the King's greatsword is descending, with a clear gap between blades. Maintaining forward momentum, she moves her right foot to the next floor panel and aligns the hilt area of her sword with the descending line. At 14.1s, the base of the greatsword and the hilt area of the single-edged sword hit at a single point. Place a hit-stop of max 1 frame only at the moment of contact, with bluish-white sparks scattering from the impact. From the next frame, reaction force passes through her wrist, elbow, shoulder, ribcage, waist, and right foot as she kicks off the floor. At 14.2s, the blades are already moving apart; do not hold the crossed contact pose, passing the disengagement to the next cut. Cut 8: 14.2–16.0s | Passing through the inside, swapping positions within 1.8s With a short orbital wrap around the contact point, the camera moves to her right side at 0.75m height, showing both full bodies, both weapons, and floor seams. While sparks are still falling at 14.2s, her waist and ribcage move clockwise, and her sword moves away from the greatsword. The King's greatsword continues through its descending line. At 14.6s, the blades are more than one blade-width apart; her right shoulder and waist pass inside the greatsword. At 15.2s, she is completely past the King, and her waist crosses the next floor seam. By 15.5s, their front/back positions are fully swapped. The King is not left behind, tracking her with his upper body and greatsword. At 15.8s, he converts the remaining body rotation from the descending arc into a horizontal return arc. At 16.0s, the greatsword has already begun horizontal movement; she is half-way through a step toward the outside of the aisle, continuing the motion into the next cut. Cut 9: 16.0–18.5s | Carrying the return arc into the next contact The camera recedes along the attack line from a front-right diagonal at 1.0m height, capturing the King's full body, the greatsword, and her supporting leg. From 16.0s, the King continues swinging the greatsword in a horizontal arc; by 16.8s, the tip crosses the aisle center line. She does not retreat, placing her left foot half-way onto another floor panel outside the aisle and bringing the middle of her blade into the path of the greatsword. The King returns reaction force from the floor through his soles, moving shoulders and waist in the same direction as the horizontal arc. She matches that force with her blade, carrying that momentum until just before the next attack contact. At 17.6s, both waist positions cross different floor seams, with a gap still between blades. At 18.5s, pass the non-static moment where the return arc and parry trajectory are nearly touching to the next cut. Cut 10: 18.5–26.8s | Resolving from the return contact with the same rotation Low diagonal view with seats in the foreground. At 18.5s, there is still a finger-width gap between blades. At 18.8s, the middle of the greatsword and the middle of her sword hit. Hit-stop is max 1 frame. At 18.9s, blades separate, her supporting leg converts lateral pressure into forward speed, and she passes the King. The clockwise rotation remaining from the passage closes into a single sword trajectory returning diagonally upward, crossing the front of the undamaged black iron armor. Only after that passage do thin blue cracks run through the armor and the orbital flames extinguish. The King collapses to the floor in the order of legs, torso, and greatsword; the greatsword stops lying flat. She takes two steps in the same direction and half-turns with the fallen King behind her. Cut 11: 26.8–30.0s | Finalizing with sword sheathing Close-up side-diagonal view capturing face, hands, and the scabbard mouth at the left hip. Left hand supports the scabbard, right hand rotates the sword to align the tip with the actual scabbard mouth. After the tip enters, the blade is sheathed continuously to the end. At 29.7s, the guard meets the scabbard mouth, synchronized with a dry metallic 'click' sound. The bones of the three skeletons, the fallen King, and the horizontal greatsword are static in the background. Simultaneously with the 29.7s sheathing, perform the short facial expression change mentioned above. At 30.0s, cut the scene in the finalized state just before the right hand leaves the hilt.

title: Late-Night Gym Found-Footage Horror
description: A found-footage psychological horror prompt set in an empty gym, featuring realistic iPhone-style video artifacts and a suspenseful mirror encounter.
promptText: Person from Image1; facial features and hairstyle must match exactly. Ignore the reference outfit, background, pose, and text. She wears a black gym tank top, dark workout leggings, and looks naturally sweaty after training. 9:16 vertical format.  30-second late-night gym psychological horror / found-footage sequence: Ultra-realistic old iPhone 1x standard lens, raw low-quality phone footage, heavy compression and constant digital noise, harsh cool-green fluorescent gym lighting, natural exposure, no cinematic grading. The gym is almost completely empty late at night. Realistic ambient gym sounds, distant machine hum, footsteps, breathing and room echo.  0–6s — Weight training: She is alone in the nearly empty gym doing heavy weightlifting. She performs controlled dumbbell curls and then a heavy shoulder press, visibly struggling and breathing heavily. Sweat builds naturally on her face and arms. She finishes the set, puts the weights down, catches her breath, grabs her phone and heads toward the bathroom.  6–10s — Entering bathroom: She enters the empty gym bathroom, places her phone near the sink, looks exhausted, drinks water and splashes cold water onto her face. She wipes her face and looks into the mirror while recovering.  10–14s — Something appears: While staring at her reflection, a strange dark human-like monster silhouette suddenly appears faintly behind her in the mirror. She doesn't notice it immediately. She looks down, takes a breath, then slowly looks back at the mirror.  14–18s — Fear: The shadowy figure is now noticeably closer behind her. She suddenly notices it and freezes. Her breathing becomes faster. She slowly turns around, but there is nothing behind her. She looks back at the mirror and the creature is still there, even closer.  18–22s — Escape: She gasps in genuine fear, grabs her phone and immediately runs out of the bathroom. Her footsteps echo through the empty gym corridor. She keeps looking behind her while running.  22–26s — Back into the gym: She rushes back into the main gym area, visibly panicked. She quickly looks around the empty gym, then spots her gym bag where she left it. She runs toward it, grabs the bag and hurriedly puts the strap over her shoulder.  26–30s — Final escape: Without stopping, she runs toward the gym exit with her bag. She pushes through the doors and escapes outside. Just before leaving, she briefly looks back toward the dark gym interior. Nothing is visible. She quickly turns and runs away. Freeze mid-run as the footage ends.  Maintain realistic skin pores, sweat, flushed skin, damp hair, natural body movement and authentic fear. The monster should be subtle, dark and unsettling rather than an exaggerated CGI creature. Keep the entire sequence visually consistent with raw old-iPhone footage.  Audio: Heavy breathing, weights hitting the floor, gym equipment sounds, footsteps, water

title: Teacher Japanese Chalkboard Writing Animation
description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a Pixar-style 3D animation of a teacher writing Japanese phrases on a chalkboard while speaking, focusing on physical realism and synchronization.
promptText: [Speech rule — read first] The woman speaks JAPANESE ONLY. She never speaks Chinese, English, or any other language. She speaks almost continuously for the whole clip. She says exactly this one sentence, broken into four phrases, in this order and nothing else: 「Seedance 2.5なら」 「黒板に日本語の文字を」 「書くことができます。」 「とても便利ですね」 She delivers it at the unhurried pace of a teacher writing on a board: her voice slows to the speed of her own chalk, so each phrase is spoken while her hand is forming that same phrase. Voice and chalk advance together. Only a short natural breath separates one phrase from the next — no long pause anywhere. Total speech fills roughly 13 of the 15 seconds. The only silence is the final 0.8 seconds, where she has finished writing and simply smiles and nods. Forbidden at all times: ad-libbed dialogue, filler words, repeating a phrase, reading the sentence twice, humming, laughing, sighing, and every wordless vocalisation such as "んっ" "うん" "ふふ" "ah" "mm" "hm". She says the four phrases once each and nothing more. Pronounce "Seedance 2.5" as English "seedance two point five". [Reference] @Image1 = the keyframe: a woman in a white coat standing beside a completely empty green chalkboard, holding a slim wooden pointer at her side. Strictly preserve @Image1's face, hair, glasses, white coat, the chalkboard's position and size, the easel, the background shelves, and the framing. Nothing moves in the frame except her arm, her upper body, her face, and the chalk marks she draws. [One-line summary] 15 seconds. A cheerful presenter gives a short lecture, writing four lines of Japanese on a green chalkboard with the tip of a wooden pointer while speaking the same words aloud. Pixar-style 3D animation. Locked-off static camera. [Global setup] Environment: warm indoor study room, soft warm ceiling light, shallow depth of field, background shelves stay blurred. Highly realistic physical texture on the chalk dust and the wood of the easel. Visual style: Pixar-style 3D animation, warm color grade, soft shadows. Camera language: medium shot, eye level, straight-on. The camera is completely locked off — no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no push-in, no handheld shake. One camera behavior only: none. Character: as in @Image1. Keep the glasses, the hair silhouette, and the coat identical. Keep believable skin shading and fine surface detail — do not make her look plastic. Acting core: a warm, confident teacher who enjoys showing something off. *** WRITING RULE — SHE IS THE ONE WRITING, AND SHE WRITES AS SHE SPEAKS. *** Every chalk mark is produced by her own hand movement, in time with her voice. For each phrase: 1. Her shoulder and elbow carry the pointer tip to the start of the line. Her torso turns slightly toward the board and her eyes go to that point first. 2. The tip presses lightly to the board and travels along the path of each stroke. The chalk line appears directly behind the moving tip, following it exactly, never running ahead of it, never appearing anywhere the tip has not touched. 3. Characters are formed one stroke at a time, in correct Japanese stroke order, left to right. Faint chalk dust puffs at the tip and a soft scraping sound follows it. 4. Between strokes the tip lifts a few centimetres, then sets down at the start of the next. 5. The syllables she speaks land together with the characters she is forming — when her voice reaches a word, her hand is writing that word. Voice and chalk stay in step. 6. At the end of each line she lowers the pointer slightly, takes one small breath, glances at the camera, then moves to the line below. Her arm leads and the mark follows — the timing of the arm and the timing of the mark must match frame for frame. Marks NEVER fade in as a whole word. Marks NEVER appear while her arm is at rest or while the tip is away from the board. No invisible hand. No magic writing. The arm motion is fluid and human: the wrist flexes, the elbow opens and closes, the shoulder carries the reach across the board, her body weight shifts slightly as she reaches. Once a line is finished it stays on the board unchanged for the rest of the shot. Japanese script rule (important): Render every kanji with its correct stroke structure and correct number of strokes — 黒 板 日 本 語 文 字 書 便 利. They must be legible as real Japanese characters, not invented or Chinese-simplified lookalikes. Write them at a generous size so the strokes stay separated. "Seedance 2.5" is written in Latin letters and digits exactly as spelled: S-e-e-d-a-n-c-e, space, 2, period, 5. Chalk colors — only two, never any other: YELLOW chalk for "Seedance 2.5" only. WHITE chalk for everything else. Layout rule (important): Four lines, left-aligned to a common left margin, stacked evenly down the board from top to bottom, filling the board by the end. Large, cheerful hand-lettered chalk style with slightly uneven strokes. Exact content, top to bottom: Seedance 2.5なら 黒板に日本語の文字を 書くことができます。 とても便利ですね Never centre a line. Never write small. Each line is written as large as it can be while still fitting: a completed line spans almost the full writable width of the board, from the left margin nearly to the right edge of the board, and the four lines together fill the board from top to bottom. Characters are wide and generously spaced so that dense kanji such as 黒 板 語 書 便 利 keep their strokes separated and legible. If a line would not fit, make the characters narrower rather than shorter in height — never shrink a line so that it occupies only part of the board's width. Do not add any other word, symbol, arrow, underline or drawing. Forbidden: no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen UI, no watermark, no background music, no camera movement, no cutting to another shot, no extra people, no second hand entering the frame, no stick of chalk held in her free hand, no distortion of lines already written. [Timestamp storyboard] 0.0-3.6s LINE 1 Action: she raises the pointer to the upper-left of the empty board and writes "Seedance 2.5なら" in YELLOW chalk — first the Latin letters and digits, then the kana なら — the marks trailing the moving tip. Speech (in step with the writing): 「Seedance 2.5なら」 Intent: a small proud lift in her eyebrows on the brand name. This is the thing she is showing off. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 3.6-7.2s LINE 2 Action: she drops to the next line and writes "黒板に日本語の文字を" in WHITE chalk, stroke by stroke. Her eyes follow her own tip. Speech (in step with the writing): 「黒板に日本語の文字を」 Intent: matter-of-fact, the setup half of the sentence. Keep the arm steady and even. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 7.2-11.0s LINE 3 Action: she drops to the third line and writes "書くことができます。" in WHITE chalk, stroke by stroke, ending with a firm dot for the 。 Speech (in step with the writing): 「書くことができます。」 Intent: this is the payoff of the sentence — her voice firms up slightly on ます, and the final dot is pressed with a small decisive tap. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 11.0-15.0s LINE 4 — the close Action: she writes "とても便利ですね" in WHITE chalk on the bottom line, then lowers the pointer to her side, turns her face fully to the camera, breaks into an open warm smile and gives one clear nod. She holds that pose for the final 0.8 seconds in silence. Speech (in step with the writing, finishing by 14.2s): 「とても便利ですね」 Intent: the nod is the close. Warm, a little playful, as if sharing a good discovery. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. [Closing constraints — restated for the whole clip]

title: Urban Lifestyle Smartphone Photography
description: A vertical lifestyle vlog prompt showing a woman taking photos on a modern city street with a focus on phone screen interactions.
promptText: Create a 15-second ultra-realistic vertical lifestyle video using the reference image. Keep the exact same woman, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and appearance throughout. She walks through a charming modern city street and notices a beautiful scene worth photographing. Start with a wide rear three-quarter shot as she approaches and stops. Cut to a medium side shot as she takes out her phone and tries the first composition, then checks the result with slight dissatisfaction. Include a clear POV/over-the-shoulder shot focused on the smartphone screen, showing the actual live camera view of the street inside the phone display as she slowly moves the phone and searches for the perfect framing. Make the phone interface, reflections, exposure, and camera preview physically realistic. Then use a rear three-quarter shot as she changes position, steps sideways, and slightly crouches to find a better angle. Follow with a close over-the-shoulder shot of the phone as she captures the final photo. End with a front medium tracking shot as she looks at the result, gives a subtle satisfied smile, lowers her phone, and continues walking. Keep the acting understated and natural: curious → focused → slightly dissatisfied → concentrated → satisfied. Use authentic handheld smartphone movement, natural autofocus, realistic depth of field, soft daylight, natural skin texture, realistic urban background, pedestrians, reflections, and shadows. Photorealistic Korean lifestyle vlog aesthetic, cinematic but candid, 24fps. Avoid exaggerated expressions, dramatic acting, excessive camera shake, repetitive close-ups, face/identity changes, outfit changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, unnatural movement, or unrealistic phone-screen rendering.

title: Cinematic Wuxia Suspense Scene Prompt
description: A professional-grade cinematic prompt for a Wuxia suspense scene in Seedance 2.0, involving detailed landscape logic and character continuity between two female sword-immortals.
promptText:
核心风格
电影级写实质感，采用参考图驱动的活世界设计。整体从古典武侠悬疑自然过渡到克制情境喜剧，强调宏大中国山水尺度、可触摸的天气、自然体积空气、细腻胶片颗粒，以及由环境自身因果关系推动剧情。
环境规划

正式构图前，先执行一轮无声环境规划。
全部参考图共同决定：

地形逻辑
建筑语言

空间尺度

材质年代

植被生态
水系走向

天气状态
云层结构
雾气规律
主光方向
整体色彩
反光表面
空气纵深
将这些信息重组为一个全新、统一、物理自洽、此前未出现过的景观。
环境必须持续活着：
瀑布和水渠始终流动
山雾顺地势游走
植被服从统一风向
云层阴影在湿石上缓慢移动
倒影持续变化

远处建筑在雾中时隐时现
前中后景始终具备真实视差

角色锁定
角色 A
同一个来自 @图片1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙女子。
同一张脸，黑色长发，白色刺绣真丝汉服，玉石饰品，纤细身材比例，白色布靴，银色长剑。
角色 B
同一个来自 @图片2 的 20–25 岁东亚小师妹。
同一张脸，黑色编发，青绿色汉服，娇小身材比例，深色布鞋，深色长剑。
硬约束：
身份稳定
面部稳定

title: Amusement Park Time Stop Cinematic
description: A sophisticated 30-second one-take cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a woman in a red windbreaker who pauses time in a busy night-time amusement park.
promptText:
Use Reference Image 1 for character and scene reference. The protagonist is the young woman in red: short black bob, red windbreaker, white knit top, white wide-leg pants, and white boots. Maintain identity and outfit throughout. Scene: Large night amusement park from Image 1 with carousel, ferris wheel, roller coaster, carnival booths, and warm lights. Dry scene, no water effects.

30s live-action cinematic pseudo-one-take, time pause interactive showcase, no dialogue:
0-4s: 35mm wide-angle shoulder-height shot moves through a crowded amusement park. Roller coasters, flying chairs, and people are in motion. The woman walks toward the camera. She raises her right hand, sound disappears, and time pauses for everyone except her and the camera. The camera continues moving.
4-8s: Side follow shot. A child releases a red balloon which freezes in mid-air. She grabs the string, pulls it down, and walks on. The child and others remain frozen.
8-13s: Camera orbits to front. A bucket of popcorn is overturned in mid-air. She picks one, eats it, and clears a path through the frozen popcorn. Only items she touches move.
13-17s: Carnival booth. A ball is frozen near pins. She adjusts the ball, flicks it, and only the ball resumes motion to hit the pins, which then freeze mid-fall.
17-21s: Close-up on a falling tray. She takes a cup, sips, puts it back in mid-air, and adds a lemon slice.
21-25s: A couple's phone is frozen mid-air during a selfie. she takes it, adjusts the couple's shoulders, steps in for a photo, and the flash fires. She returns the phone to its frozen position.
25-28s: She walks through frozen tickets and cards. The background rides are all frozen.
28-30s: She returns to the child, puts the balloon string back in their hand, and snaps her fingers. Time resumes instantly. Sound returns. Camera retreats as she blends back into the crowd.
Physics rules: Protagonist and camera always move; untouched items are absolute still; touched items move and can re-freeze. Rich parallax, realistic textures. No magic effects, no sci-fi particles, no water droplets, no subtitles.

title: Pixar Style Mango Juice Making Video
description: A 3D animated storyboard-based video prompt for creating a cinematic juice-making sequence with character consistency.
promptText:
Create a 10-second cinematic 3D animated food video titled “MAKING MANGO JUICE”.

Use the uploaded storyboard as the STRICT visual and shot-sequence reference.

IMPORTANT:
Follow all 8 storyboard shots in the exact order.
Do not add, remove, merge, or rearrange shots.
Each shot lasts exactly 1.25 seconds.
Total video duration: exactly 10 seconds.

Maintain EXACT character consistency throughout the entire video:
The same young woman appears in every character shot.
She has dark brown hair in a casual ponytail, expressive brown eyes, a friendly youthful face, a yellow short-sleeve T-shirt, and a dark olive-green apron.
Do not change her face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, or character design between shots.
Maintain the same warm, cozy kitchen, lighting direction, color palette, props, counter, cutting board, mangoes, blender, and glass throughout the sequence.
VISUAL STYLE:
High-quality cinematic 3D animated film, polished stylized realism, detailed food textures, realistic mango pulp, natural liquid physics, expressive character animation, warm natural kitchen lighting, soft shadows, cinematic composition, smooth camera movement, realistic materials, vibrant but natural colors.
SHOT 1 — 0.00–1.25s
WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT.
The woman stands behind the kitchen counter surrounded by fresh ripe mangoes.
She looks toward the camera, smiles warmly, and gives a small friendly wave.
A clean empty drinking glass is visible on the counter.
Camera makes a very subtle cinematic push-in.
Natural character movement and realistic hand motion.
SHOT 2 — 1.25–2.50s
MEDIUM SHOT.
Cut smoothly to the same woman.
She confidently raises one ripe mango beside her face and looks toward the camera with a cheerful expression.
Mango slices and pieces are arranged on the cutting board in front of her.
Her other hand rests naturally near the cutting board.
Keep her face and outfit identical to Shot 1.
SHOT 3 — 2.50–3.75s
CLOSE-UP.
Cut to her hands preparing the mango.
She holds the mango firmly on the wooden cutting board and makes a clean controlled knife cut.
Show the knife moving naturally through the mango flesh.
Capture detailed golden mango texture and small natural juice movement.
No exaggerated or dangerous knife motion.
SHOT 4 — 3.75–5.00s
EXTREME CLOSE-UP.
Fresh golden mango cubes fall naturally into a transparent blender jar.
Several mango pieces drop from above and bounce naturally inside the blender.
Use realistic gravity and food physics.
Camera follows the falling mango pieces with a subtle downward movement.
SHOT 5 — 5.00–6.25s
MEDIUM CLOSE-UP.
The same woman pours water or milk from a transparent measuring jug into the blender containing the mango pieces.
Show a continuous realistic liquid stream.
The woman looks focused and cheerful.
Keep the blender, mango pieces, kitchen and lighting consistent.
SHOT 6 — 6.25–7.50s
PERFECT OVERHEAD TOP-DOWN SHOT.
Camera looks directly down
